goal: Close the trusted plugin runtime, registry, dependency, removal, and deployment-profile contract.
description: Validate explicit profile selection, deterministic dependency order, immutable contributions, fail-closed activation, sandbox-only governed execution, reverse shutdown, physical plugin removal, and complete absence of unselected plugin surfaces.

acceptance_criteria.text: Explicit deployment profiles bind the exact plugin identities and digests; absent, invalid, unknown, disabled, duplicate, cyclic, or dependency-incomplete selection fails closed without a synthesized default.
Selected plugin registration, immutable contribution publication, rollback, reverse shutdown, and activation failure propagation are deterministic.
Removing every unselected optional plugin artifact leaves core bootable and exposes no operation, route, tool, UI, state-machine, hook, storage, background, or static surface.
Plugins receive no raw host path, process, socket, credential, sandbox backend, container, or virtualization handle; governed executable work uses only the core SandboxExecutionPort.

commit.message: feat: close plugin runtime and profile selection
commit.target: plugin contracts, registry, runtime composition, deployment profile, removal tests, and sandbox boundary
